thread:
maria: Quick follow-up on the kernel selection rollout RFC — I have a proposed gating plan we should agree on.
ajay: nice, lay it out
maria: TL;DR: per-model feature flag + traffic cutover + automated fallback to legacy kernels. Start canary at 1% for 24h, then 10%, 50%, 100% with automated rollback if error-rate > 1% or p95 latency regresses > 15% vs baseline.
kelly: sounds reasonable. what about per-customer opt-out (enterprise customers)?
maria: yep, plan includes an allowlist/exclude list in flags, and an override in dedicated config. example flag schema:
maria: ```json
{
  "flag": "kernel_v2",
  "rules": [
    {"type":"model","id":"open-llama-13b","enabled":true},
    {"type":"customer","id":"acct_123","enabled":false},
    {"type":"percent_rollout","value":0.01}
  ]
}
```
sam: minor: percent_rollout should be deterministic per request id so users get sticky behavior across retries
ajay: agree. sticky bucketing by request_id % 10000 is fine. note: need to propagate bucket in edge so region routing stays consistent
luca: fallback kernels — do we keep the old kernel in the same process or spin a separate runtime? cost/perf tradeoff
maria: separate pool preferred for isolation. cheaper to keep old kernel on CPU for tiny fallback? but CPU fallback will be slow; better to run legacy kernel on same GPU if capacity allows, else fall back to earlier quantized variant.
kelly: operational question: who gets alerted on automatic rollback? need paging flows + slack notifications + canary dashboard widget
maria: paging to eng-oncall + runtime-oncall. deploy-bot will post a canary summary to #eng-runtime. example notification:
maria: "deploy-bot: [canary] kernel_v2 open-llama-13b 1% -> error-rate 1.6% -> rollback initiated"
ajay: what about per-model kernel configuration API? should be an admin-only endpoint returning effective kernel and flag status
sam: +1. Also require validation on write to prevent enabling kernel_v2 on models we haven't validated. maybe a whitelist in model-metadata
luca: long-term: move flag evaluation into the router service for lower-latency decisions; short-term use a sidecar config cache to keep rollout latency low
kelly: ok let's capture action items
maria: action items:
- ajay: implement sticky bucketing and edge propagation (ETA 2w)
- sam: add validation for model whitelists (ETA 1w)
- luca: prototype separate fallback pool architecture (ETA 3w)
- kelly: add alert + dashboard widgets (ETA 1w)
- me: update RFC doc with gating matrix + rollback thresholds (ETA 3d)
maria: any objections? otherwise I'll update the RFC and send to product for sign-off
ajay: no objections from me
sam: good
luca: fine
kelly: go for it :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: canary job scheduled: kernel_v2 canary for open-llama-13b at 1% starting now
maria: thanks all, I'll post the updated RFC link shortly
